Lightweight sky & water shader for OptiFine and Iris (1.16.5–26.3). Adds realistic volumetric clouds, sun and moon with phases, god rays, sun glare and lens flare, plus waves that reflect the sky, sun and moon. No shadows, vanilla lighting stays.
